profile.headline: Information Technology Quality Assurance Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Are you someone who values Quality in your organization? If so, I would love to connect.

I am a Quality Assurance professional with organizational QA experience across multiple industries; including clinical patient facing, administrative quality review, and IT software development settings. 

My focus is on improving the organization through taking a thorough detailed approach in process quality improvement. Innovation and continuous improvement is central to the advancement of internal testing and quality review processes. Adopting novel methodologies, approaches, and technology are crucial to improve efficiency while maintaining high quality standards.
 
I am proficient in quality assurance, leadership, team management, process improvement, auditing, research and development, learning and development, clinical case management, and software testing. I am committed to providing forward facing, top-tier auditing and quality assurance services in an organization.

Currently working towards completion of a Masters in Business Administration (Expected date of completion: 2024).

positions.title: Information Technology Quality Assurance Software Engineer
positions.description: Works on and tests software projects by reviewing project user stories and working with other organizations (both within and outside of IT) to understand the complete requirements of the project, including the system software architecture, design, internal and external interfaces. Create and test cases in conjunction with the client. Document software defects and identify areas of improvement, report defects to software developers. Identify, analyze, and document problems with program function, and output in testing environments prior to implementation into production.
positions.insights: Quality Assurance, Cross-team Collaboration and +8 skills

positions.insights: Internal Communications, Case Management and +4 skills

positions.insights: Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Auditing and +4 skills
